CSJMU Kanpur Opens Recruitment for 36 Teaching Posts: Key Dates and Details

Key takeawaysChhatrapati Shahu Ji Maharaj University (CSJMU) in Kanpur has officially announced a new recruitment drive for teaching positions, offering a total of 36 vacancies for Assistant Professor and Associate Professor roles under Advertisement Number CSJMU/Gen.Admin/980/Teach

Chhatrapati Shahu Ji Maharaj University (CSJMU) in Kanpur has officially announced a new recruitment drive for teaching positions, offering a total of 36 vacancies for Assistant Professor and Associate Professor roles under Advertisement Number CSJMU/Gen.Admin/980/Teaching.

Candidates interested in pursuing academic careers at the university can now review the official notification and submit their applications online.

Important Dates and Application Process

The online application process for the CSJMU teaching posts commenced on September 26, 2026. Applicants must complete their submissions and fee payments by the final deadline of October 31, 2026.

  • Application Start Date: September 26, 2026
  • Last Date for Application and Fee Payment: October 31, 2026
  • Total Vacancies: 36 posts
  • Roles: Assistant Professor / Associate Professor

Applicants can pay the required fees online using multiple payment methods, including debit cards, credit cards, internet banking, IMPS, and mobile wallets/cash cards as supported by the portal.

Eligibility and Guidelines

According to the university's recruitment guidelines, candidates are generally required to hold a graduation or post-graduation degree from a recognized university or institute. Age relaxation policies are applicable in accordance with standard CSJMU regulations.

Practical Implications and Verification

Prospective applicants should carefully review the official notification hosted on the university's portal before filling out any forms to ensure they meet all specific criteria regarding qualifications, age limits, and documentation requirements.

  • Confirmed Details: The recruitment covers 36 vacancies for teaching posts under advertisement number CSJMU/Gen.Admin/980/Teaching. The application window runs from September 26, 2026, to October 31, 2026.
  • Unknown/Unspecified Details: Specific salary structures, detailed category-wise breakdowns, and exact age limit boundaries are not detailed in the preliminary notices and require checking the official notification document.
  • How to Verify: Readers can verify all details and access the application portal directly by visiting the official CSJMU website at [https://csjmu.ac.in/](https://csjmu.ac.in/) or reviewing updates via the source reference at [Sarkari Result](https://sarkariresult.com.cm/csjmu-kanpur-teaching-post-2026/).
